moments.title: Premier League Weekend Roundup
moments.blurb: Sunday's Premier League action saw Manchester City beat rivals Manchester United 1-0, while Arsenal secured a 2-0 win against Sunderland and Chelsea drew 2-2 with newly promoted Hull City.

angles.name: Derby Day Drama
angles.copy: Manchester is still blue after City edged out United 1-0 in yesterday's derby! Haaland with the winner. #ManchesterDerby

angles.name: Arsenal's Strong Start
angles.copy: Arsenal keep up their winning ways with a 2-0 victory over Sunderland yesterday. Title challengers or early season form? #COYG

angles.name: Promoted Sides Hold Their Own
angles.copy: Hull City held Chelsea to a 2-2 draw, and Ipswich Town beat Crystal Palace 3-2. The newly promoted teams are certainly making their mark in the Premier League! #PremierLeague

moments.title: Sienna Spiro Scores UK No.1
moments.blurb: 20-year-old British artist Sienna Spiro has landed her first UK Official Singles Chart Number 1 with 'Great Expectation', becoming the youngest British female artist to top the chart since 2014.

angles.name: New Chart Queen
angles.copy: Huge congrats to Sienna Spiro on her first ever UK No.1! 'Great Expectation' is officially the biggest song in the country. #SiennaSpiro

angles.name: Young Talent Shines
angles.copy: At just 20, Sienna Spiro is the youngest British female artist to hit No.1 since 2014! What a moment for 'Great Expectation'. #NewMusic

angles.name: Chart Topper
angles.copy: From climbing the charts to hitting the top spot! Sienna Spiro's 'Great Expectation' is your new Official UK Number 1. Tune in to hear it! #OfficialCharts

moments.title: Strictly Come Dancing Returns
moments.blurb: The 24th series of Strictly Come Dancing kicks off with its launch show this Saturday, September 19th, at 7:25 PM on BBC One, introducing new hosts Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe, and Johannes Radebe.

angles.name: Strictly is Back!
angles.copy: Get ready to cha-cha-cha! Strictly Come Dancing returns this Saturday with a brand new line-up and new hosts Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe & Johannes Radebe. Who are you backing? #Strictly

angles.name: New Faces, New Moves
angles.copy: Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe, and Johannes Radebe are taking the reins as hosts for this year's Strictly! Catch the launch show this Saturday, 7:25pm on BBC One. #StrictlyComeDancing

angles.name: Dance Floor Drama
angles.copy: The Glitterball Trophy is calling! Strictly Come Dancing's launch show is this Saturday, revealing this year's celebrity-pro pairings. We can't wait! #BBCStrictly

moments.title: Great British Bake Off Returns

angles.name: Bake Off is Back!
angles.copy: On your marks, get set... BAKE! The Great British Bake Off returns next Tuesday, 22nd September, 8pm on Channel 4. And there's a new judge! #GBBO

angles.name: Nigella in the Tent

angles.name: Soggy Bottoms Incoming
angles.copy: Who's ready for some showstoppers and a few soggy bottoms? The Great British Bake Off is back on Channel 4 next Tuesday! Alison & Noel are ready. #GreatBritishBakeOff

angles.name: London Calling Adele
angles.copy: Adele reportedly recording new music in London for a potential 2026 album release. We're keeping our ears peeled! #AdeleNewAlbum
